description: This file defines a Java class 'SpecifiedCacheSupportingCacheManager' that implements the 'CacheManager' and 'InitializingBean' interfaces. It manages caching support by delegating to a 'JCacheCacheManager' for supported cache names, with fallback to a 'NoOpCacheManager'. It includes methods for initialization, retrieving caches, and configuring supported cache names.

classes.name: SpecifiedCacheSupportingCacheManager
classes.description: A custom CacheManager that supports specific caches by delegating to an underlying cache manager for supported cache names, with fallback to a no-operation cache manager.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the cache manager by asserting that dependencies are not null and calling afterPropertiesSet on the delegate cache manager.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache by name. If supported, tries to get it from the delegate cache manager; if not found, falls back to no-op cache manager.

methods.name: getCacheNames
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable collection of supported cache names.

methods.name: setDelegateCacheManager
methods.description: Setter for the delegate cache manager.

methods.name: setNoOpCacheManager
methods.description: Setter for the no-op cache manager.

methods.name: setSupportedCaches
methods.description: Configures the set of supported cache names.
